newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary overnight rates surge to close at 23 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary overnight rates surge to close at 23 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates surged five percentage points on Monday but were expected to stabilise for the week, traders said.
O/N rates closed at 23 percent compared with Friday's 18-percent close.
"It is the first day of the (banks' two-week) reserve period, and everybody is building up reserves," said Sandor Tolonics of Budapest Bank.
He expects O/N rates to remain slightly above the central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo, currently at 22.50 percent. -- Denes Albert, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
